name: Santa Fe
summary_text: National sources: a record 2025 with at least 227 hate crimes on SOGI grounds (+62% year-on-year, one every 38 hours; security-force-perpetrator cases doubled, 17 to 64), the 2025 executive decrees amending the Gender Identity Law and prison housing (national, applies to every province), and trans activists' testimony on the resulting hostile climate. Against that frame this province is one of the few that measures its own exposure: the provincial government publishes violent-death statistics that include transfemicidios and travesticidios, Rosario hosts the Observatorio Mercedes Pagnutti monitoring gender violence, and national registers name Santa Fe transfemicide victims. No province-specific statute or enforcement series with a source was found.

sources.title: Argentina's transgender community confronts 'chaotic, desperate' situation
sources.claim_summary: Washington Blade (10 Apr 2025): trans activists in Buenos Aires say President Milei's policies have made the community's situation chaotic and desperate, more vulnerable to violence, discrimination and poverty; his government closed the Women, Gender and Diversity Ministry and INADI (2024) and dismissed trans public-sector workers hired under the Trans Labor Quota Law; the country's former special envoy for LGBTQ rights says LGBTQ+ people are in a bad moment for rights and quality of life. National picture, April 2025.

sources.title: Crímenes de odio en Argentina: aumento y récord de uno cada 38 horas - Agencia Presentes
sources.claim_summary: Agencia Presentes (19 Mar 2026): the National Hate-Crime Observatory counts a record 2025 — at least 227 crimes based on sexual orientation or gender identity, up 62% year-on-year, one every 38 hours; most perpetrators were security-forces personnel or strangers in public spaces, with beatings the leading modality; security-force violence cases rose from 17 (2024) to 64 (2025). Named provincial incidents: police interventions in the deaths of three LGBT+ people in Salta, Córdoba and Buenos Aires provinces (18–26 Nov 2025), and a provincial prison-service raid in Buenos Aires province (14 Apr 2025).

sources.title: Milei modified the Gender Identity Law by decree: what changed and why are they asking for judicial intervention? - Agencia Presentes
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (HTTP 500); the underlying source covers decree 62/2025 amending the Gender Identity Law (banning transition treatments for under-18s) and a companion decree on the housing of trans people in prisons — both challenged in court as unlawful. National-level: applies to every unit.
